versions.changelog:
Initial release of aliyun-image-generator skill.

- Generates high-quality images via Aliyun Tongyi Wanxiang, triggered only when input starts with "千问画个图".
- Strict trigger condition: Skill activates only for prompts beginning with "千问画个图".
- Expands user prompts into detailed image descriptions (50–100 words).
- Handles API Key requirements: Requests and stores user's Aliyun API Key if not configured.
- After generation, returns the local file path of the generated image to the user.
